answer: Demand a sequential proof-of-elapsed-time per identity — a verifiable delay whose steps must run one after another, uncompressible by adding cores. Each head must present its own crystal chain of iterated hashes computed in real wall-clock, and no two can be shared because each is seeded to one key. A single honest worker runs one falcon-swift sequence per epoch. A farm cannot parallelize away the delay: N identities need N sequential timelines on finite hardware, so the clock itself becomes the gale that scatters the fold-many-into-one trick.
